official_title: ENGLISH Preparatory Schools - Year Two - Term 1
subject: ENGLISH

units.description: Explores Gen Alpha, daily life, trends, and technology usage using the Present Continuous tense.
Covers privacy, digital habits, and online safety using Present Simple, Passive, and modal verbs.
Focuses on overcoming challenges, courage, and determination using the Past Simple and Past Continuous tenses.
Discusses art, artists, materials, and expression using Cause, Result and Contrast connectors.
Explores different countries, cultures, and landmarks using Comparative and Superlative Adjectives.
Highlights inventors and innovative machines using Conditional sentences (type 1 and 2).

front_matter.description: Covers front cover, title page, copyright information, message from the Ministry of Education and Technical Education, and the Scope and Sequence.

back_matter.description: Contains the table of contents and lesson components overview.
